description: Demand for a steadily selling SKU at ST06 fades from 2026-03-16: it all but stops selling there while its stock stays on hand. After two weeks of usual trading, detection should flag a slow mover on 2026-03-22 or 2026-03-23. The Analyst should blame fading demand, not a stock or data problem, and the Ops agent should alert the inventory planner at Tier 1 to stop reordering it. A slow mover is never answered with a Reorder.
